title: Hydrolytic Reactivity of a Samarium(II) Organometallic Complex: Synthesis and Structure of a Hexametallic Organosamarium Oxide Hydroxide, [(C5Me5)Sm]6O9H6

material_class.structural_family: distorted octahedral Sm6 oxide-hydroxide cluster with a central μ6-O and eight face-bridging oxygens

synthesis.procedure: Under nitrogen, a THF solution of (C5Me5)2Sm(THF)2 (140 mg, 0.248 mmol in 10 mL THF) was placed in one side of an H-shaped tube equipped with high-vacuum stopcocks and a connecting frit. A degassed solution of 4.5 μL H2O in 5 mL THF was placed in the other side. Both solutions were degassed by freeze–pump–thaw. The vessel was sealed and hydrolysis was allowed to proceed over two weeks via vapor-phase contact. Brown, THF-insoluble crystals of 1 (33 mg, 40%) were isolated by filtration.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: H-shaped tube with high-vacuum stopcocks and connecting frit; freeze–pump–thaw degassing; vapor-phase hydrolysis under nitrogen
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Brown THF-insoluble crystals isolated by filtration; crystals suitable for X-ray diffraction formed directly.
